profile.summary:
Inquisitive, Creative, Results-focused Sr. Software Engineer with strong communications skills and 15+ years of  experience providing innovative solutions to business and user challenges. Expertise in the software product development process, ideation, technical design, prototyping, and automated testing. Technologies include Go, Node.js, Python, PHP, PostgreSQL and MySQL. Solutions Architect proficient in AWS Cloud  IAM, Step Functions, Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge.

I am unique in the engineering space. Many developers claim to be full-stack, but I am truly full-stack and beyond from brand development, UI and print design, to front-end dev, to back-end. I have expert level skills in all three areas. My design experience includes brand development and print design and publishing as well as digital. I have extensive experience in high-volume image/digital asset processing and management.

I have worked in a startup environment, corporate, and boutique design and development firms. I am seasoned at working with global, distributed and cross-cultural teams. I also speak French at an intermediate (B1-B2) level.

projects.title: Go Concurrent Batch Image Conversion
projects.description:
A high-performance, concurrent image processing CLI written in Go for large-scale batch conversion pipelines. It supports processing files from either local storage or AWS S3 using a pluggable service layer, making it ideal for both cloud and local workflows. The tool recursively scans directories or buckets, converts SVG → PNG (rsvg-convert) and PNG → WebP (ffmpeg), optionally applies watermarks, and saves outputs locally or to S3.

Built for speed and scalability, it leverages Go’s concurrency model with a configurable worker pool, processing over 500,000 images in just 45 minutes—compared to ~6.4 hours in Python (8 workers) and ~11.6 days in Node.js (single-threaded). Its interface-driven architecture, robust error handling, and config-based orchestration make it easily reusable for any high-volume media processing task.

projects.title: VectorIcons.net Multi-vendor E-commerce Architecture
projects.description: This is a curated subset of the service-oriented architecture backend for VectorIcons, a multi-vendor marketplace for SVG icons & illustrations, shared for portfolio purposes. It is not runnable as-is due to removed infrastructure dependencies (authentication layers, payment processing, deployment configurations, and proprietary database connections). This repository demonstrates architecture, code quality, testing practices, and systems thinking.
